description: Small Ralph self-iteration for the current branch. There is no GitHub PR/check suite for this branch yet (`gh pr status` reported no PR; `gh run list --branch ralph/self-iteration-20260519-044235 --limit 5` returned no runs). Main branch CI for the immediately prior merge completed with a Web job failure after PRD inspection began: `npx vitest run --coverage` failed in `src/vertex/VertexWorkspacePage.test.tsx` because the test asserted the async graph title after waiting only for the always-mounted canvas shell. Local health probes before the failure completed were otherwise clean: `npm --prefix web test -- --run` (268 files, 2798 tests), `npm --prefix web run build`, and `go test $(./scripts/ci/go-packages.sh)`. The highest-priority target is repairing the fresh main CI failure before continuing with OSv2 upper-layer gate-strengthening work.

userStories.name: Repair Vertex workspace coverage-mode graph title gate
userStories.description: Make the Vertex workspace test deterministic under Vitest coverage instrumentation by waiting for the loaded graph title instead of treating the initially rendered canvas shell as fetch completion.
bdd_acceptance: Given `/vertex/{rid}` initially renders the canvas shell while graph metadata is still loading, When the graph fetch later resolves with `name: "Alpha"`, Then the test waits until `vertex-topbar-graph-name` contains `Alpha` before asserting.

Given Vitest coverage instrumentation slows async React state updates, When the Web CI command runs, Then `src/vertex/VertexWorkspacePage.test.tsx` no longer races by asserting the RID fallback as the final graph name.

Given `/vertex/new` has no graph metadata fetch, When the existing empty-canvas test runs, Then it still asserts the initial shell and passive TopBar controls without waiting for a title that will never load.

userStories.name: Make the US-444 lineage gate assert wired endpoints
userStories.description: Strengthen the US-444 lineage Playwright probe so a full E2E stack fails loudly when property-lineage or dataset-column impact endpoints are unavailable instead of skipping core lineage coverage.
bdd_acceptance: Given the Northwind seed exposes customer full metadata, When `us444/13-lineage-view.spec.ts` probes a seeded customer property, Then missing metadata, missing property RID, or an unwired property-lineage route fails the test instead of calling `test.skip`.

Given dataset-column impact is a wired lineage surface, When the spec calls `/api/v2/lineage/dataset-columns/impact` with a synthetic dataset and column, Then it asserts a structured response with an `impacted` array and rejects 404/5xx responses.

Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When `us444/13-lineage-view.spec.ts` is parsed, Then both lineage scenarios remain discoverable and the spec has no `test.skip` or `test.fixme` guards.

userStories.name: Make US-444 branch lifecycle gates reject unwired branches
userStories.description: Strengthen the branch and merge smoke specs so full-stack US-444 runs fail when branch lifecycle, diff, or merge endpoints are absent rather than accepting 404 as a passing degraded mode.
bdd_acceptance: Given the Northwind ontology branch endpoints are wired, When `us444/06-branch.spec.ts` creates, lists, and closes a branch, Then 404 responses fail the test instead of being skipped.
Given a quiet branch has no diverged changes, When `us444/07-merge.spec.ts` calls diff and merge, Then diff and merge must return wired endpoint statuses and must not accept 404 as success.
Given Playwright runs in list-only CI discovery, When the branch and merge specs are parsed, Then both scenarios remain discoverable without permanent skip/fixme guards.
quality_gates: `npm --prefix web exec playwright test -- --list us444/06-branch.spec.ts us444/07-merge.spec.ts`
`rg -n "test\\.(skip|fixme)\\(" web/e2e/us444/06-branch.spec.ts web/e2e/us444/07-merge.spec.ts` must return no matches
